The 41-year-old forward has returned to Riyadh ahead of Friday's Saudi Pro League clash against Al-Diriyah, with Postecoglou confirming that Ronaldo is in good shape, both physically and mentally. > Cristiano has returned to the club in good physical and mental shape. Asked about Ronaldo's situation, Postecoglou said ahead of Al Nassr's league game against Al Draih on Thursday: "Ronaldo played for us with full commitment and his morale is very high.
